analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has entered oversold territory (36.9), but the ADX at 20.0 indicates an early stage of trend formation, making direction confirmation premature. The 5-day low ($1.27) is higher than the 20-day low ($1.26), opening the possibility of a 'Higher Low' pattern, but the volume ratio of 0.84 suggests a lack of momentum. SMA100 ($1.29) and SMA200 ($1.28) may act as support, but given the level above the 52-week low ($0.99), further downside potential appears limited.
